a: هَلِّلُويَا. سَبِّحُوا اللهَ فِي قُدْسِهِ. سَبِّحُوهُ فِي فَلَكِ قُوَّتِهِ.
e: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.

a: سَبِّحُوهُ عَلَى قُوَّاتِهِ. سَبِّحُوهُ حَسَبَ كَثْرَةِ عَظَمَتِهِ.
e: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.

a: سَبِّحُوهُ بِصَوْتِ الصُّورِ. سَبِّحُوهُ بِرَبَابٍ وَعُودٍ.
e: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.

a: سَبِّحُوهُ بِدُفّ وَرَقْصٍ. سَبِّحُوهُ بِأَوْتَارٍ وَمِزْمَارٍ.
e: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.

a: سَبِّحُوهُ بِصُنُوجِ التَّصْوِيتِ. سَبِّحُوهُ بِصُنُوجِ الْهُتَافِ.
e: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
